mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates on future corporate earnings and increases equity valuation multiples, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of central bank rate cuts and reduces inflation expectations, thereby boosting equity risk appetite and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve in the form of rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate, signals a weakening supply-side economy, which increases the likelihood of monetary stimulus and drives equity market gains over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both INDPRO falls below its 12-month MA and UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) over the past two months, combined with stagnant GDP growth (GDPC1), indicates a weakening demand environment that triggers a policy pivot toward stimulus, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 0.5% MoM and GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS declines and GDPC1 growth is below 1.0%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum, combined with a sustained increase in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a stable unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%), indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200k and UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the interaction term in a regression is not positive and significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 550k, combined with a concurrent drop in real personal consumption (RSAFS), signals a collapse in consumer confidence and demand, which leads to a policy response and positive equity market rebound over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST < 550k and RSAFS declines > 0.3% MoM, or the joint signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of cases.
